title: Indoor CO2 Ventilation Reminder
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture and greenhouse sensors (`plant:sensor`), aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airgradient:sensor
| stats latest(co2_ppm) as co2, avg(co2_ppm) as avg_co2 by room
| where co2>1200
| sort - co2
description: Flags rooms where carbon dioxide has climbed high enough that opening a window or changing ventilation is the obvious next move.
value: High CO2 often shows up first as stuffiness or fading focus; a direct reminder beats trying to infer it from how the room feels.
implementation: Forward AirGradient or similar indoor air metrics; alert when room CO2 exceeds your preferred threshold.
visualization: Room table of current and average CO2 concentration.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which rooms need fresh air because the carbon dioxide level has climbed too high.
